headline: Amazon SageMaker FFT Feature Paves Way for Enhanced AI Customization
summary: Amazon SageMaker now supports Full Fine-Tuning (FFT), a technique that could outperform Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in certain scenarios. This advancement is expected to accelerate local AI agent deployment and reduce costs associated with closed APIs.
whyItMatters: It broadens access to advanced AI customization techniques and reduces the reliance on proprietary platforms, fostering innovation and competition in the AI space.
